description:
Check a conversion you started with `convert_document`.

Returns `task_id` and `task_status` (`pending`, `started`, `success` or
`failure`). On `success` it includes the `markdown` when it is under
100 KB, otherwise a `result_url` to download the full result with your
API key (free). On `failure` it includes `error`, one sentence with the
reason. Results are deleted 7 days after submission. Requires an API key.

Credits: free. This tool is not metered.
name: get_conversion
title: Check a Docling conversion
